description.value: Apricus Cellars is a boutique winery situated within the District Wine Village in Oliver — Canada's first multi-winery village concept of its kind. Founded as a partnership between Indigenous and non-Indigenous owners, it produces whites, rosés, and reds from South Okanagan fruit grown minutes from the winery. Touring cyclists can purchase bottles on-site or ship wines home through the online shop, and the venue also hosts live music events on its patio.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Apricus Cellars is an active winery at 104 – 100 Enterprise Way, Oliver, BC V0H 1T2, with phone (236) 488-1096 — neither phone nor full address appear in OSM tags, so contact_confirmed reflects what can be cross-checked. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those all remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule. The business is clearly open and publicly accessible, located within the District Wine Village.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number or full street address — contact details sourced from website only and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible winery at a known Oliver commercial address with an active website and upcoming events; a legitimate stop for touring cyclists passing through the South Okanagan.
